## 📦 Installation

Add `{{PACKAGE_NAME}}` to your project's `alya.toml`:

```toml
[dependencies]
{{PACKAGE_NAME}} = "{{VERSION}}"
```

Or reference directly via Git:

```toml
[dependencies]
{{PACKAGE_NAME}} = { git = "https://github.com/{{REPOSITORY}}.git", tag = "{{TAG}}" }
```
